request.input:
1girl, solo, standing in a vast silver reed field, arms gently spread at waist height, both open palms visible, relaxed fingers. Body turned slightly toward screen-right, face looking back toward the viewer, quiet composed expression.

Wide landscape, eye-level three-quarter view, girl near center, visible from head to knees, lower legs hidden by reeds. Dense diagonal windblown reeds fill the foreground with soft out-of-focus plumes, smaller reeds lead toward a low distant horizon. Wind blows her hair, jacket and red pennants toward screen-right. Slender weathered poles with long red ribbons on the left and scattered far behind her; tiny white birds across an expansive dramatic cloudy sky.

Sunset after a windy day, dark blue-gray clouds edged with glowing amber light, warm backlight from screen-right, luminous silver reed plumes, golden rim light on hair and shoulders, softly illuminated face and hands, deep cool foreground shadows, cinematic atmosphere, finely resolved face.
